evidence_class: Local isolated fixture in CI: real git against bare file origins in pytest temporary execution roots laid out by SV2-FSY-01; correct mirror, wrong origin mirror, stale base and four concurrent preparations. Nothing mocked except monkeypatched git failures and timeouts in named refusal tests. Not live rollout proof.
interfaces: scripts.swarm_v2.workspaces.identity(url): normalized, credential free origin identity for https, ssh, git, file and scp origins; credential, query and fragment origins and unsupported schemes raise WorkspaceError

scripts.swarm_v2.workspaces.prepare(execution, request, reuse=True) -> Workspace: under an exclusive lock in the checkout root, verifies a cached mirror by origin identity, clones into a staging folder beside the mirror, runs an atomic pruning fetch, resolves the base, refuses a base that lacks Request.minimum, names the branch through scripts.swarm.naming, records origin and base atomically before git worktree add; replays the same task generation and fences an older one

scripts.swarm_v2.workspaces.Request(origin, task, generation, agent, base='dev', minimum='') and Workspace(path, branch, mirror, project, base, base_commit, task, generation, workspace_prepare_seconds)
scripts.swarm_v2.workspaces.recorded(execution, task) and mirror_path(execution, project, reuse); WorkspaceError for every refusal

supported_versions.python: 3.11 and 3.12 unit shards in the linked CI run
supported_versions.git: the git shipped on the ubuntu-latest CI runner; worktree add, fetch --atomic --prune and for-each-ref are required
supported_versions.origins: https, ssh, git, file and scp style origins; http and credential bearing origins are refused

states.committed: The workspace record written atomically under the checkout root before the worktree is added

measurements.workspace_prepare_seconds: Workspace.workspace_prepare_seconds, monotonic time from the prepare call to the materialized worktree, saved in the record; the package cases assert it is measured on every preparation
measurements.dimension: Per preparation, returned on the Workspace

rollback_rehearsal.action: prepare with reuse=False ignores the cached mirror and clones fresh beside it under an attempt suffix, so archive references in the old mirror stay valid
rollback_rehearsal.data_safety: The cached mirror is never deleted or rewritten by a refusal or by disabled reuse; records and worktrees of earlier tasks survive a failed preparation

observed.result: With reuse off, a fresh clone landed beside the cached mirror at the fresh base and the cached mirror kept its references; a wrong origin folder at the cached path was ignored rather than reused

scope.scripts/swarm_v2/workspaces.py: owned path; clone or fetch a verified repository into the worker local cache, create the task worktree from the fresh base, keep canonical branch naming through scripts.swarm.naming, record base commit and origin identity before the first edit
scope.tests/test_swarm_v2_workspaces.py and te: required fixture: correct mirror, wrong origin mirror, stale base and concurrent worktree preparation; cases A, B, C
scope.evidence/SV2-FSY-02: evidence record with the pull request and tested commit
scope.profiles/package/skills/worktree/: unchanged; the existing development cycle naming and dev base are reused through scripts.swarm.naming

remaining_limitations: No ssh BatchMode default, because it would override an operator core.sshCommand; a prompt hang is bounded by GIT_TIMEOUT (600 seconds)
A password stored in a pre-existing mirror's configuration is not rechecked on reuse
A preparation resumed from its record reports placeholder seconds
An scp origin with an at sign in a slash free path is refused, which fails closed
workspace_prepare_seconds values are returned per preparation but not printed by CI, so this record carries no measured figure
Nothing launches prepare in a live Pod yet; the worker launch package consumes it
